locations: Yamuna forest edge beneath the full moon
continuity.narrative_arc: Krishna's flute call draws the gopikas from home; hurried adornment and inward devotion lead to their arrival before him and Bhattathiri's closing prayer.
continuity.krishna_form_contract: Where Krishna appears as the youthful Vrindavan cowherd, follow the shared krishna-vrindavan-youth contract: a serene youthful figure with deep matte blue skin, long dark naturally curly hair, yellow dhoti, muted red-orange shawl, a plain smooth forehead with no mark, and one simple low gold band with a single upright peacock feather. Show one face, two attached arms and hands, and two legs and feet with ordinary youthful human proportions. Do not use these markers for infant, child, adult divine, or Dwaraka king forms, and do not insert Krishna into scenes where he is absent.
continuity.supporting_cast_contract: Gopikas are distinct ordinary adult women with different faces and hair, natural proportions and modest opaque village saris. Within repeated group scenes, maintain three unnamed recurring visual cues: a long-braided woman in muted maroon, a low-bun woman in earth ochre, and a side-braided woman in muted olive. These do not assign names or change the shared gopikas contract. Show household and maternal contexts with dignity. Every figure remains fully clothed; haste is conveyed through unfinished ornaments or paused tasks, never exposed skin. In S009 only, Bhattathiri is the older clean-shaven devotee from the provided identity cue, with a simple cream dhoti and modest cream upper cloth.
continuity.palette_arc: Flat opaque matte mineral fields in cream, earth ochre, maroon, muted olive and established deep blue. Move from cool moonlit forest to warm household and devotional stillness without gloss, metallic reflections, cinematic light or outer borders.
continuity.reference_mapping: Nine caption numbers map to canonical stanzas 1–9 per accepted-readiness.json; filenames are retained as supplied. Images 010–011 are preserved text extras and remain unmapped.
continuity.batch_selection: Nine native landscape candidates are selected for an unapproved reference-versus-candidate comparison chapter; independent exact-checksum review is recorded in art/reviews/visual-reviews.json. No artwork approval is implied.
recurring_gopika_visual_cues: Within repeated group scenes, keep three unnamed gopikas visually identifiable: a long-braided woman in muted maroon, a low-bun woman in earth ochre, and a side-braided woman in muted olive. These are continuity cues only, not named or approved identities.
Keep their faces, hair and natural proportions consistent whenever the same woman reappears; any additional gopikas have distinct faces and hairstyles, never duplicate clones.
